name: Alarma Recordatorio
description:
Countdown timer and alarm clock in the top bar.

* Add or subtract minutes with one click, or set a time of day
* The top bar shows when the next alarm rings today
* Write a reminder message
* Get reminded with a dialog (with Snooze), a fading on-screen message or a system notification, with an optional repeating sound
* Alarms like GNOME Clocks: days of the week, name, own sound, ringing time and snooze
* Survives screen locks and restarts: an alarm missed while the screen was locked is shown on unlock

Inspired by Reminder Alarm Clock, written from scratch for GNOME 50. Available in English and Spanish.
